name: formcoach-tennis-strokes
input: Descriptor of one rep counted by the FormCoach engine, computed by ml/strokes.py rep_features() from the engine's Samples; ports must compute the same features in the same order. Missing (null/NaN) values are replaced by normalization.impute.
inference: z = (x_imputed - mean) / std; for each task p = softmax(weights @ z + bias)

serve_type.reliability: experimental: close to chance (33%) in grouped CV; do not show to users as a verdict. Flat/kick/slice differ mostly in racket-face and ball-toss details a front-view 2D wrist track cannot see.

training_data.citation: S. Gourgari, G. Goudelis, K. Karpouzis, S. Kollias. THETIS: Three Dimensional Tennis Shots, a human action dataset. CVPR Workshops (CVPRW), 2013, pp. 676-681.
training_data.licence_note: THETIS is distributed for research purposes. This model was trained on it for research/prototyping; check the dataset's terms (and contact the authors) before any commercial use, and retrain on licensed data for a product release.
training_data.input_pipeline: RGB videos (Kinect, 640x480, mirrored; un-mirrored here) -> MediaPipe Pose (ml/extract_pose.py) -> FormCoach engine (shared/sport_profiles.json tennis, front view, right-handed)
